scripts.build:poki: tsc --noEmit && VITE_PORTAL=poki vite build --outDir dist-poki && rm -f dist-poki/assets/hdri/*_4k.hdr dist-poki/assets/textures/*_2k.jpg && cd dist-poki && zip -qr ../fairway-legends-poki.zip .
scripts.build:crazygames: tsc --noEmit && VITE_PORTAL=crazygames vite build --outDir dist-crazygames && rm -f dist-crazygames/assets/hdri/*_4k.hdr dist-crazygames/assets/textures/*_2k.jpg && cd dist-crazygames && zip -qr ../fairway-legends-crazygames.zip .
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@13 deploy --only hosting,database
